Official NPM SignalsmithStretch.mjs:113867bytes, Gitblob7d5cae72e77a84143ed91ba12fc91b806dc4d9d1, SHA25697530b11d5bc01015af4cde40d6aa55ff10c40aa1294ca4c8c5762027d517a46; matches the pinned official release exactly.
TropeTrain packaging: prepend the MIT notice, empty local CommonJS bindings and packaging comments; append export default SignalsmithStretch. The compiled loader/WASM bytes between them are unchanged. No CDN or extra runtime download is used. Original C++/WASM adapter remains available at the pinned source link; a deterministic rebuild has not been independently verified.
TropeTrain uses the reported input+output latency and zero padding to retain the original sample count. Formant compensation is requested; pitch, transient behavior and vocal timbre are approximate. Original source recordings and word times remain unchanged. No communal tradition, historical Kinnor preset, pronunciation equivalence, new voice or reviewed cantillation grammar is inferred. Derived audio is session-only; original recording/timing licenses and attribution remain in assets/references/NOTICE.txt. Independent acoustic, phonological and cantorial review pending.
